answer:
Allowed origins (CORS) are defined in `worker\src\index.ts`, lines 21–31, inside the `cors({ origin: (origin) => {...} })` config passed to `app.use('*', cors({...}))`.

Currently allowed:
- Exact match `http://localhost:4200`
- Any subdomain ending in `.pages.dev`
- Any subdomain ending in `.workers.dev`

To add a new custom domain, edit that `origin` function in `worker\src\index.ts` — add another condition in the `if (...)` block, e.g.:
```ts
origin === 'https://your-custom-domain.com' ||
```
or `origin.endsWith('.your-custom-domain.com')` for subdomain matching, then return `origin`. That's the single source of truth for allowed browser origins.
